'''Masami Toyoshima''' (Japanese: '''豊島まさみ''' ''Toyoshima Masami'') is a Japanese voice actress for {{aniseries|PTS}}. She was born on April 24, 1965 in {{wp|Tokyo}}, {{wp|Japan}}. Toyoshima's most famous role in the series is that of [[Delia Ketchum]], {{Ash}}'s mother.
